About

Fusion Updates (fusionupdates.com) turns Oracle's quarterly readiness documentation into a filterable, plain-English list of changes across Oracle Fusion Cloud, with impact ratings and a what-to-test checklist for every update.

It is run by an experienced Oracle consultant. Every entry links back to its Oracle source page. Summaries are condensed from Oracle's text, and impact ratings are editorial judgment, so always check the Oracle page and your own configuration.

This is an independent site, not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle.

Method: features come from the "Feature Summary" tables in Oracle's What's New documents. Enablement comes from Oracle's "Action to Enable" column plus the Current Opt-In Expirations list. Impact: high means users have to change how they work, or it's a large UI or process change, a former opt-in that becomes standard and affects users, or it touches payments, accounting, integrations or security. Medium means visible but contained, or switched on automatically and noticeable. Low means minor, cosmetic, reporting-only, or it needs setup before anyone gets it. Each rating is checked against Oracle's feature page (description, action to enable, scale and opt-in status).
